title: New: The State of Software Delivery in Healthcare
partialText: 168 healthcare tech leaders were surveyed on software delivery. 68% say speed and risk are in constant tension. We broke down what's really behind it and what separates innovative teams from the rest.

title: Sign in with Google for React Native
partialText: Modern Sign in with Google for React Native using Android's Credential Manager, the GoogleSignIn-iOS SDK, and a first-party Expo config plugin. TypeScript-first.

title: What founders told us about working with AI tools for startups
partialText: AI can help you ship a prototype in a weekend, but it won't tell you if you're building the right thing. We talked to founders who use AI tools every day to find out where it actually helps, and where it can quietly hurt you.
